description: Three levels of grid, which is here to say that nothing about the nesting is two-deep special-casing: the levels are peeled into a list and lifted in turn, so the cell the marks are drawn in is `child_child_child_width` and the partitions chain `facet` to `child_facet` to `child_child_facet`. The heading fold runs the same way — the two column levels caption together as `a / c` while the row level between them captions its own rows, per channel and not per level.
